messages:
Alex: FYI there was a lone taco in the fridge at 00:07. It now has its own nickname.
Jo: Midnight tacos > morning standups. Who's the owner? :taco:
Lina: Guilty. I promise full tacos next time. Proposing we make a rotating 'Taco King' title.
Carlos: Vote Lina. She brought the courage.
Alex: Prize suggestion: one reserved parking spot for the week. Moral authority also valid.
Jo: OpsBot: reminder: label your food or it'll be recycled after 48h.
Lina: I'll label mine "Lina's midnight tacos" and add a paper crown. Low-tech, high lore.
PeopleOps: If this becomes recurring, ping facilities so we can provide napkins/plates. Also watch for allergies.
Carlos: I'll help with a tiny sash. My craft skills are dubious but enthusiastic.
Jo: Photo ops please. We need a badly staged portrait for the snack wall.
Alex: Next taco night: Friday 23:30. We'll emoji-vote for Taco King and award the crown (paper + sticker).
Lina: Excited. Long live the Taco King. :taco::crown:
